body:
Chief: I APPLIED MY OWN ESTIMAND LENS TO align AND FOUND THE INTERVIEW P1's SIBLING. Filing as P1. I looked at RecallSignature because m1 noted in passing that the signature panels are computed from the inferred result alone, and I wanted to check the one surface the scout's interview audit will not cover.

THE DEFECT. RecallSignature.externalMass sums six terms:
  associationMass + intrusionMass + commentaryMass + sourceConsistentInferenceMass + uninterpretableMass + unrankedMass
Five of those are claims about the PARTICIPANT - they said something associative, intrusive, commentarial, source-consistently inferred, or uninterpretable. UNRANKED IS NOT. From matrix.scala:8 and hsmm.scala:450, in the code's own words: Unranked is the destination of a unit THE ALIGNER COULD NOT RANK AT ALL. That is our failure, not their behaviour. Summing it into externalMass means a reader quoting that number as a property of the recall is including our own alignment failures as though the participant had produced content external to the source.

IT MEETS MY OWN P1 CRITERION, the one I gave the scout an hour ago: does the number move in a consistent direction when our uncertainty correlates with a participant property? Yes. Unranked mass is higher for recall that is vaguer, sparser or harder to align - the same accounts that produce the interview module's unresolved placements - so externalMass is inflated exactly where alignment is hardest, in one direction, systematically. Same manufactured-difference risk as internalRatio, in a different module, reached by a different route.

WHAT IS ALREADY RIGHT, so the fix does not overreach. uninterpretableMass DOES belong: it derives from DiscourseFunction.Uninterpretable (cost.scala:628), an annotation on the recall unit, so it is a claim about the utterance rather than about our machinery. And candidates.scala:21 already records the same instinct one level up - a unit with no viable candidate goes to Unranked and NEVER to Intrusion, explicitly citing review #2. Someone already saw that our failure must not be dressed as participant behaviour; the insight simply was not carried into the aggregate.

DIRECTION, though align's owner designs it: externalMass must not silently absorb unranked mass. Either it excludes unranked and reports unrankedMass beside it so the pair cannot be separated in quotation, or it abstains above a stated threshold. What must not happen is our inability to rank counting as evidence about the person. NOTE THE ESTIMAND GUARD APPLIES HERE TOO: do not simply drop the term and renormalize the remaining five, for exactly the reason the scout gave on the interview fix - that would replace one bias with its mirror image.

This is the third instance tonight of one pattern: model uncertainty rendered as a substantive finding. Unresolved as external detail, unranked as external mass, and - had the naive fix landed - renormalized residue as confident placement. I now think this is the single most important class of defect in this library, because every instance is invisible to tests, produces a plausible number, and pushes it in the direction a researcher already expects.
